name: 通園支援事業者に性暴力防止措置を義務づけ
summary: 条例に、乳児等通園支援事業者が児童対象性暴力等を防ぐための規定を加えます。利用乳幼児と接する業務のうち、支配性・継続性・閉鎖性のある環境で働く人の犯罪事実確認などを行い、発生時には利用乳幼児を適切に保護するための措置を求めます。2026年12月25日に施行します。

en.name: Requires childcare support providers to prevent sexual violence against children
en.official: Regarding the enactment of an ordinance partially amending the Tama City Ordinance on Standards for Facilities and Operations of Infant and Other Childcare Support Services
en.summary: The ordinance will add provisions requiring providers of infant and other childcare support services to take measures to prevent sexual violence against children and other such acts. These measures include checking the criminal records of workers whose duties involve contact with children using the service in an environment involving control, continuity and limited openness. The ordinance also requires measures to appropriately protect children using the service if such an act occurs. It will take effect on December 25, 2026.
changes: Require measures to prevent sexual violence against children and other such acts, and to protect children using the service if an incident occurs
Require criminal record checks and other measures for workers who interact with children using the service in certain environments
who: Providers of infant and other childcare support services
Workers whose duties involve interacting with children using the service in an environment involving control, continuity and limited openness
